subject.title: fix(plugins): preserve already-loaded plugins across scoped harness activation

question: Should scoped harness activation merge newly loaded harness surfaces into the existing active registry, or is re-registering every active plugin an intentional supported lifecycle contract?
rationale: The current patch chooses a global plugin lifecycle policy that affects registration side effects, pinned surfaces, reload semantics, and failure coupling; source inspection cannot establish that policy intent safely.

options.title: Merge registry state
options.body: Load only missing harness plugins and preserve or merge existing runtime registry objects without re-executing unrelated plugin registration.

options.title: Support full re-registration
options.body: Explicitly adopt full active-plugin re-registration, document the lifecycle contract, and add stateful-plugin, failure, and performance proof before merge.

options.title: Pause this approach
options.body: Keep the linked issue open while designing a canonical registry ownership and scoped-activation API.

recommendation.title: Merge registry state
recommendation.body: Load only missing harness plugins and preserve or merge existing runtime registry objects without re-executing unrelated plugin registration.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person with the plugin registry architecture whose lifecycle contract must be selected.
